property_summary: For any non-zero address a, calling transferOwnership(a) from a (a non-owner) must revert; the reference reverts because require(msg.sender==owner) runs first, while the mutant executes the body first so owner becomes a and the trailing require succeeds, making the call pass.
change_summary: Move the _; statement before the require so the function body executes before the ownership check, meaning transferOwnership still updates owner and then reverts.
